items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Terminology 8:1
items.html: It means a doubled HaVaYaH: for Yod is two Yods, Hey-Hey are two Heys, Vav-Vav are two Vavs, and Hey-Hey are two Heys. Its indication is that it has no filling of its own, but only from the HaVaYaH above it. (p. 605, Item 10)
